Sources.Notes: SOAP 1.1/1.2 WSDL contract for the 'MagnetMail Web Service' (targetNamespace http://www.magnetmail.net/). This is the machine-readable contract of record for this vendor -- treated at the OpenAPI/GraphQL-SDL tier for ranking purposes since it is the ONLY machine-readable schema the vendor exposes (no OpenAPI/Swagger/GraphQL SDL/Postman collection exists for this legacy ASMX/.NET SOAP service). Fetched via plain HTTP GET (no auth required to read the WSDL itself; auth (username/password via Authenticate + the mmAuthHeader SOAP header) is required to actually INVOKE operations).
